messages.subject: Vholes / Ashbourne — without prejudice
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Jonathan,

We act for Ashbourne Healthcare Group. Please find attached our without prejudice letter setting out the proposed terms, together with a first draft of the settlement agreement. As flagged, our client is open to a sensible adjustment to the non-compete duration but not to the client or employee non-solicitation covenants.

The offer is open for 14 days. Do call if helpful.

Kind regards,

Sarah Whitfield
Partner — Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100

messages.subject: RE: Vholes / Ashbourne — without prejudice
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sarah,

Thank you. My client is broadly minded to settle. He won't accept a 12-month non-compete given the move is in train, and asks for it to come out altogether. On the money, he feels the ex gratia element is light relative to his service. We'll send a marked-up draft shortly.

Regards,
Jonathan Vane
Partner
Castle & Vane LLP
